method: Posterior mean of Beta(k_d + alpha, n_d - k_d + beta) under Beta-Binomial conjugacy. weight = (k_d + alpha) / (n_d + alpha + beta). (alpha, beta) is the EB hyperprior for the (sector, L1) cell from Phase 2; degenerate cells and unfit sectors fall back to Beta(1, 1) uniform per the eb-hyperpriors.json fallback_policy.
